title: Spectral-Embedded Operator Learning for Three-Phase Interfacial Flow: A Ternary Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.29069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Operator-learning surrogates have been benchmarked largely on single-field, single-interface problems, leaving unclear whether architectural choices validated in those settings transfer to constrained, multiphase flows. We introduce a three-phase interfacial-flow benchmark to examine whether the trunk coordinate representation matters for a multi-channel, interface-dominated target. The configuration consists of an air bubble rising through water, piercing a water-oil interface, and entraining a water plume into the oil within a bounded, wall-confined domain. Reference data are generated using a structure-preserving ternary Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes solver that algebraically preserves the simplex constraint. From 1,024 Sobol-sampled simulations spanning a nine-dimensional parameter space, we learn the mapping from physical parameters to five-channel space-time fields. translated_title: 面向三相界面流的谱嵌入算子学习：一个三元Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes基准测试
translated_abstract: 算子学习代理模型此前主要在单场、单界面问题上进行基准测试，因此尚不清楚在这些设置中验证过的架构选择能否迁移到受约束的多相流问题中。我们引入一个三相界面流基准测试，以检验主干坐标表示对于多通道、界面主导的目标问题是否重要。该配置模拟了一个气泡在水中上升、穿透水-油界面，并在有界、壁面受限的域内将水羽流卷入油中的过程。参考数据由一个结构保持型的三元Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes求解器生成，该求解器在代数上保持单纯形约束。基于跨越九维参数空间的1,024个Sobol采样模拟，我们学习从物理参数到五通道时空场的映射。我们比较了三个参数匹配的DeepONet变体，它们仅在……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于三元Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes求解器的三相界面流基准测试，利用1,024个Sobol采样模拟来检验主干坐标表示对多通道、界面主导的DeepONet算子学习架构选择的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a three-phase interfacial-flow benchmark based on a structure-preserving ternary Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes solver, using 1,024 Sobol-sampled simulations to examine whether trunk coordinate representations matter for parameter-matched DeepONet variants on multi-channel, interface-dominated targets.
